unlisted_practices: Evaluate GenAI clinical decision support outputs in critical care using a structured, consensus-validated framework (IMPACT) with domains of integration, mastery, precision, applicability, comprehensiveness, and timeliness rather than textual similarity metrics.
Revise the IMPACT evaluation framework periodically as AI technology and clinical practice evolve.
Adapt the evaluation framework to local care settings and translate it linguistically and culturally before international use.
Use granular evaluation rubrics with standardized scoring anchors to improve inter-rater reliability when scoring GenAI outputs.
Link GenAI evaluation scores to patient outcomes through prospective studies.

screen.reason: This study develops and validates an evaluation framework (IMPACT) for generative AI in critical care via an expert consensus panel process rather than empirical testing of AI outputs or deployment outcomes.
